jobs.prompt: Fix these Opus review findings in tools/gate-rerun.mjs and extend tests/gate-rerun.test.mjs (existing module, not wired). HIGH 1: test ids from pytest output are passed as raw arguments; only parse the 'short test summary info' section, match lines from column 0, accept only ids matching ^[\w./-]+\.py(::\S.*)?$ with no leading '-', no '..' segment and not absolute, and put '--' before the ids in the rerun argv. HIGH 2: for node:test the file named in a location or 'test at' line becomes an argument unchecked: reject a leading '-', require a relative path that stays inside cwd (path.resolve check) and that looks like a test file. HIGH 3: the node argv rebuild is wrong: for ['node','--import','./tests/_isolate-config.mjs','--test','{affected}'] it drops the value of --import, runs the setup file as a test and passes the literal {affected}; skip the value after flags that take one (--import, --require, -r, --loader, --test-reporter, --test-reporter-destination, --test-concurrency=N style stays single) and drop {affected} and other placeholder arguments; assert the exact resulting argv in the test. MED 4: redaction runs after cutting to maxBytes so a secret crossing the cut survives in part: redact the full captured output first (keep a margin) and then cut to maxBytes. MED 7: escapeRegExp must escape '*' and every regex metacharacter, and the --test-name-pattern values must be anchored ^...$. MED 9: Bearer pattern case-insensitive; add ghp_, gho_, github_pat_, xox[abp]-, AKIA[0-9A-Z]{16}; add AUTH, CREDENTIAL, PASSWD, PRIVATE, COOKIE, DSN to the env-name pattern. LOW 10: kill the group only when Number.isInteger(child.pid) && child.pid > 1. LOW 11: keep separate timer variables and declare the timeout timer before attaching handlers (a spawn that emits error synchronously must not hit a TDZ error). LOW 12: only redact env values of 6 or more characters. LOW 13: setEncoding utf8 and count bytes with Buffer.byteLength; keep tail bytes of stdout and stderr fairly (each gets at least a quarter). LOW 15: remove the dead line. Make the kill function injectable (killImpl option) and use it in the timeout test instead of replacing the global process.kill. Add tests for: ids or files starting with '-', containing '..', absolute; exact node argv; a secret crossing the trim point; a regex metacharacter in a test name; invalid or missing pid. IMPORTANT: the repository's secret scanner blocks test files with literal secret-looking assignments: in tests build fake secret values at run time (concatenation or repeat) and use neutral variable names. Keep every existing test passing unless it asserts the buggy behaviour described here (then fix that assertion).

Fix these Opus review findings in tools/gate-fingerprint.mjs and extend tests/gate-fingerprint.test.mjs (existing module, not wired). MED 5: saveGateCapture must redact every string in the capture before writing (import the redaction helper redactRerunTail from tools/gate-rerun.mjs, which already exists; pass the env). MED 6: the 256 KB trim must keep the END of the tail field (tail.slice(-n)), and if the capture is still too big after trimming the tail and other string fields, truncate those fields or throw a clear error; never write more than 256 KB. MED 8: write the temp file with flag 'wx' and an unpredictable name (crypto.randomBytes), delete the temp file when rename fails. LOW 14: lstat the gate-failures folder and refuse it when it is a symlink or owned by another user (process.getuid), do not ignore a failed chmod, and drop the extra chmod after rename (mode 0o600 is set at write). Add tests for: redaction of an input string containing a Bearer token, the trim keeping the end, a planted symlink at the temp path or folder refused, oversize capture handling. IMPORTANT: the repository's secret scanner blocks test files with literal secret-looking assignments: in tests build fake secret values at run time (concatenation or repeat) and use neutral variable names. Keep every existing test passing unless it asserts the buggy behaviour described here (then fix that assertion).
